metadata.title: Liftable braid factorizations from line arrangements: Hironaka's relations and a Zariski pair
metadata.abstract: We realize Hironaka's generalized lantern relations by lifting positive braid factorizations. For a nonpencil real line arrangement with no parallel lines, we construct a family of branched coverings on the regular fibers of a blown-up pencil of spheres. The motion of the branch points gives a factorization of a power of the full twist into least liftable powers of half-twists. The Artal-Carmona-Cogolludo-Marco Zariski pair gives two such factorizations of the same braid for a single simple branched covering of the disk. Their lifts are Hurwitz inequivalent even up to simultaneous conjugation by page homeomorphisms. The corresponding Milnor fibers fill the same planar contact three-manifold and have the same incidence matrix. They are homeomorphic and lie in distinct strong symplectic deformation classes.

analysis.workSummary: 由无平行线且非pencil的实线排列构造分支覆盖，运动分支点给全扭转幂的正半扭转可提升分解，提升实现Hironaka广义lantern关系。
techniques: 线排列与吹起球面铅笔
正辫分解及最小可提升幂
analysis.breakthrough: 某Zariski对给同一辫的两个分解，提升后即使允许整体页共轭仍Hurwitz不等价。对应Milnor纤维填充同一平面接触三流形、同胚且关联矩阵相同，但强辛形变类不同。
analysis.limitations: 结论对应文中具体覆盖与排列，不等价范围需保留整体共轭条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
